class.name: OcgBreptoolsShapeset
class.brief_description: Contains a Shape and all its subshapes, locations and geometries.
class.description: ! Contains a Shape and all its subshapes, locations ! and geometries. ! ! The topology is inherited from TopTools.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Builds an empty ShapeSet.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Builds an empty ShapeSet.

method.name: IsWithTriangles
method.description: Return true if shape should be stored with triangles.

method.name: IsWithNormals
method.description: Return true if shape should be stored triangulation with normals.

method.name: SetWithTriangles
method.description: Define if shape will be stored with triangles. Ignored (always written) if face defines only triangulation (no surface).

method.name: SetWithNormals
method.description: Define if shape will be stored triangulation with normals. Ignored (always written) if face defines only triangulation (no surface).

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears the content of the set.

method.name: AddGeometry
method.description: Stores the geometry of <S>.

method.name: DumpGeometry_1
method.description: Dumps the geometry of me on the stream <OS>.

method.name: WriteGeometry_1
method.description: Writes the geometry of me on the stream <OS> in a format that can be read back by Read.

method.name: ReadGeometry_1
method.description: Reads the geometry of me from the stream <IS>.

method.name: DumpGeometry_2
method.description: Dumps the geometry of <S> on the stream <OS>.

method.name: WriteGeometry_2
method.description: Writes the geometry of <S> on the stream <OS> in a format that can be read back by Read.

method.name: ReadGeometry_2
method.description: Reads the geometry of a shape of type <T> from the stream <IS> and returns it in <S>.

method.name: AddShapes
method.description: Inserts the shape <S2> in the shape <S1>. This method must be redefined to use the correct builder.

method.name: ReadPolygon3D
method.description: Reads the 3d polygons of me from the stream <IS>.

method.name: WritePolygon3D
method.description: Writes the 3d polygons on the stream <OS> in a format that can be read back by Read.

method.name: DumpPolygon3D
method.description: Dumps the 3d polygons on the stream <OS>.

method.name: ReadTriangulation
method.description: Reads the triangulation of me from the stream <IS>.

method.name: WriteTriangulation
method.description: Writes the triangulation on the stream <OS> in a format that can be read back by Read.

method.name: DumpTriangulation
method.description: Dumps the triangulation on the stream <OS>.

method.name: ReadPolygonOnTriangulation
method.description: Reads the polygons on triangulation of me from the stream <IS>.

method.name: WritePolygonOnTriangulation
method.description: Writes the polygons on triangulation on the stream <OS> in a format that can be read back by Read.

method.name: DumpPolygonOnTriangulation
method.description: Dumps the polygons on triangulation on the stream <OS>.
